summary: Inuvo, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of 1,631,121 common shares at $1.00/share and pre-funded warrants for 1,337,693 shares at $0.999/warrant, alongside a private placement of Class A and B warrants exercisable at $1.28/share. The last sale price was $1.36 on June 29, 2026. Ladenburg Thalmann acts as placement agent with a 6% fee. The securities are immediately separable; warrants become exercisable in six months. Proceeds before expenses total roughly $2.79M. Watch for market reaction to the dilutive offering and potential exercise of warrants.
